text:
```yaml
name: Release Trigger

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run the release process without actually releasing'
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  validate-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run release validation script
        run: |
          python release_validation_script.py --dry-run ${{ github.event.inputs['dry-run'] }}
```
